import ctypes
import os

def allocate_bspline_workspace(spline_order, nbreak):
    # Validate input parameters before calling GSL
    if spline_order < 1 or nbreak < 2:
        return None
    
    # Load GSL libraries in correct order
    try:
        cblas = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
        gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')
    except OSError:
        return None
    
    # Define the function prototype
    gsl.gsl_bspline_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_bspline_alloc.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    
    # Call the function
    workspace_ptr = gsl.gsl_bspline_alloc(spline_order, nbreak)
    
    # Check if allocation was successful
    if workspace_ptr == 0:
        return None
    
    return workspace_ptr
